headlines.description: — Brad Marchand scored in the fourth round of the shootout in his return to Florida's lineup after missing two games to give the Panthers a 5-4 win over the Boston Bruins, his former team, on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchand scores in shootout, Panthers beat Bruins, his former team, 5-4

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Zach Werenski became the first defenseman to score 20 goals before an Olympic break, Jet Greaves got his second shutout of the season and the Columbus Blue Jackets extended their winning streak to seven with a 4-0 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks...
headlines.shortLinkText: Werenski's milestone and Greaves' shutout lead Blue Jackets to 7th straight win, 4-0 over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Brendan Gallagher and Josh Anderson each had a goal and two assists, Samuel Montembeault stopped 36 shots to earn his first win since Jan. 17 and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Winnipeg Jets 5-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens beat Jets 5-1 to extend points streak to 5 games

headlines.description: — Matt Boldy scored three times in the first 13 minutes and assisted on Jared Spurgeon's goal with 45.1 seconds left on the clock in overtime to lead the Minnesota Wild over the Nashville Predators 6-5 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Boldy nets early hat trick and Spurgeon scores in OT as Wild beat Predators 6-5

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Josh Manson scored the tiebreaking goal in the third period and the NHL-leading Colorado Avalanche beat the San Jose Sharks 4-2 in their final game before the Olympic break Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lehkonen scores 2 goals and MacKinnon reaches 700 assists as Avalanche sink Sharks, 4-2

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Nick Schmaltz and Clayton Keller had a goal and an assist each, Karel Vejmelka made 29 saves, and the Utah Mammoth beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Utah beats Detroit 4-1 for 8th win in last 10 home games

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Stars captain Jamie Benn snapped a 15-game goal drought by scoring twice, including the game-winner with 23 seconds left, and Dallas beat the St. Louis Blues 5-4 on Wednesday night to go into the Olympic break with a six-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson gets 200th goal, Benn scores 2 and Stars top Blues 5-4 for 6th straight win

headlines.description: — Matvei Gridin had a goal and an assist for the rookie's first multipoint game in the NHL, leading the Calgary Flames to a 4-3 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lomberg scores tiebreaking goal in 3rd and Flames top scuffling Oilers 4-3 to take season series

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Jack Eichel had a goal and an assist and the Vegas Golden Knights snapped a five-game losing streak with a 5-2 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Golden Knights end 5-game skid with 5-2 victory over Canucks

events.name: Seattle Kraken at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Shane Wright scored twice to lead the Seattle Kraken to a 4-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shane Wright's 2 goals lead Kraken to 4-2 victory over Kings
